column3: sharpit migrate runs alembic upgrade heads in a child; success message "Alembic upgrade completed." when Alembic logging hides the count, and the shared single-flight 409 body for migrate (P-M3) deviate from BootUI; engines registered on several different databases answer 404 because one alembic.ini drives one database (engines on the same database are one target); confirm must be JSON true only (strict); a structured beanName (list or object) answers 400 in sharpit's error shape, not Spring's; a scalar beanName is coerced to its text; Alembic not installed is 404 unavailable as BootUI missing provider
